subject: pre-release of 0.8-8 and new Google Site

messages.author: df74d6fccec2ff7e
messages.subject: pre-release of 0.8-8 and new Google Site
parts:
Hi everyone,

I'm about to release a new version with some bug fixes and documentation improvements, but I thought I would give people a chance to test it out first and provide feedback. If you feel like doing so, a beta version is available here:

https://sites.google.com/site/unmarkedinfo/home/pre-releases

This is a new site for miscellaneous unmarked stuff that I made because Google Groups doesn't allow files to be uploaded anymore. If anyone wants to help improve or maintain this site, let me know.

When I release 0.8-8, I'll provide a list of changes, but for now you can look at:

https://github.com/rbchan/unmarked/commits/master


Richard

messages.author: 6a288128bce8283d
messages.subject: Re: pre-release of 0.8-8 and new Google Site
parts:
Hi Richard,

Thank you for putting this up. I will give it a try, but as I only use
the occu function I don't anticipate any problems as I haven't read
anything about changes in there.

One thing I would like to point out in general is your 'Hierachical
Modeling Course' website. This is a great resource for getting started
with unmarked as well as with R2WinBUGS (as I just found out). I would
like to thank you very much for making this available online and was
wondering what you think about putting the link up on the pages
section here or maybe even in the documentation somewhere?

Cheers,
Richard

messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] Re: pre-release of 0.8-8 and new Google Site
parts:
Ok, I'll put a link to the course in the DESCRIPTION file. Thanks for your input.

Richard

ps. The new release (and the pre-release) will require >=R-2.12.0, and there will be 32- and 64-bit versions available. Upgrading R is necessary because the R developers made some major changes to the way packages are structured.
